examples.text: „Ich hatte Sheila E. aufgelegt – ein Kompromiss zwischen Mainstream-Smasher und kredibler Qualität, den man machen kann, finde ich.“
While WMRE makes clear that electrification is the only credible option to decarbonise, it says that bi-mode trains could be used in the interim.
What society classifies as “credible” is almost always a product of whichever social demographic happens to be economically dominant at the time of the classification.
